Design the **loading** state of the Settings screen for **mifos-x-open-banking**, a Open Banking KMP super-app - consumer retail banking + field officer agent banking powered by Open Bank Project API v7, built with Compose Multiplatform across Android, iOS, Desktop, and Web Material 3 balanced dark theme, 393×852dp (Pixel 5), Outfit font throughout.

Palette: primary #B2D188, on_primary #1F3701, primary_container #354E16, on_primary_container #CDEDA3, secondary #A0CFCB, on_secondary #003735, secondary_container #1F4E4B, on_secondary_container #BCEBE7, tertiary #A0CFCB, on_tertiary #003735, tertiary_container #1F4E4B, on_tertiary_container #BCEBE7, error #FFB4AB, on_error #690005.
